dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with high-contrast, serrated white perimeters. These structures transition abruptly from high-intensity white at the edge to low-intensity grey or black in the interior, with three distinct closed annuli aligned along the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial clusters of high-intensity white pixels lacking internal gradients are visible on the lower-left lateral surface. These blobs appear in high-density groupings of 4-6 units with core pixel concentrations significantly higher than the surrounding dark pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships between the centroids of the four largest macro-annuli form an irregular kite-like quadrilateral pattern across the central dorsal plane, with angles varying based on the curvature of the animal's posture.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent transverse dermal fold is visible at the neck-torso junction, creating a continuous dark furrow that lacks the high-contrast ringed texture present elsewhere.
